problem_text:
A logistics firm must coordinate a circuit of twelve regional distribution hubs, each positioned at specific grid references:

Hub Beta: (1,189)
Hub Gamma: (137,131)
Hub Delta: (109,12)
Hub Epsilon: (31,98)

Hub Lambda: (139,169)

Due to a permanent infrastructure limitation, no direct transport link exists between Hub Alpha and Hub Beta.
Furthermore, owing to a contractual exclusivity clause, the final routing plan must incorporate exactly one of the following two critical connections: either the link between Hub Beta and Hub Gamma, or the link between Hub Gamma and Hub Delta.

The objective is to determine the minimal total distance circuit that visits every hub precisely once and concludes at the initial point of departure.
